title: The Snow Pass
hook: It looks into the shed. Don't move.
synopsis: The Hush is faster up the mountain. At the top of the pass hangs a roof of heavy snow, and Rook has one long whistle.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Next stop: Pine Town. Hold the bar!
The valley lamps went out. It's here.
It's coming up the valley. Full steam!
It's faster uphill! Come on, old girl!
Look at all that snow up there...
The pass is closed. It can't see us.
Into the snow shed. Nice and slow.
It will be back. Hold the bar.
